title: DPWH contractors and the GAA lines their contracts carry, FY2016–FY2026
notice: Independent and unofficial: our reading of DPWH’s contract list and the GAA, not an official record. Contractor names, license numbers, amounts and statuses are as DPWH’s list publishes them; amounts are contract amounts, not payments. DPWH does not publish which GAA line a contract carries: the links are our match by title, office and amount, and may be wrong. A contract, a total or a ranking alone does not establish irregularity or wrongdoing by any contractor, office or official.

sources.name: DPWH contract list
sources.via: bettergovph/api.dpwh (cached proxy over DPWH’s transparency portal)

method.same_year: a line is compared only with contracts funded from the same year’s GAA
method.left_out: several contracts for one line (splits): a sample check found a third right

accuracy.note: Confirmed = a component title of the fetched contract equals the line’s (ratio ≥ 90). Most of the rest are the same project worded differently; by hand about 1 in 100 one-to-one links is wrong.

files.title: DPWH’s contract list, FY2016–FY2026
files.about: Every contract in DPWH’s list as downloaded, all its list fields, one row per contract; with DPWH’s page for each.

columns.contract_id: DPWH contract ID, as its contract list has it (e.g. 23AE0052).
columns.dpwh_url: DPWH’s own page for the contract on its transparency portal.
columns.description: Contract description, as listed (DPWH cuts it at 255 characters).
columns.component_categories: Infrastructure types of the contract’s components, as listed.
columns.status: Completed, On-Going, Not Yet Started, Terminated or For Procurement.
columns.contract_php: Contract amount in pesos, as listed (centavos kept). Not a payment.
columns.amount_paid_php: Amount paid, as listed (mostly 0 in the list).
columns.dpwh_office: The DPWH office holding the contract ("La Union 1st DEO", "Region V").
columns.contractor: Contractor(s) with license numbers in brackets; joint-venture partners separated by " / "; some licenses tagged "[REVOKED]". Empty for contracts not yet awarded.
columns.program_name: Regular Infra or Outside Infra, as listed.
columns.source_of_funds: Fund source, as listed ("Regular Infra - GAA 2023 SSP").
columns.gaa_year: The GAA year named in source_of_funds; empty when it names none.
columns.report_count: Reports on the contract in DPWH’s portal, as listed.
columns.has_satellite_image: Whether DPWH’s portal has a satellite image, as listed.
columns.is_live: Whether DPWH’s portal shows a live stream, as listed.
columns.livestream_video_id: Live stream video ID, as listed.
columns.livestream_detected_at: When the live stream was detected, as listed.

files.title: Every DPWH contractor, with its figures
files.about: One row per contractor (by license number): contracts, amounts by year, joint ventures, offices, GAA lines matched.

columns.contractor: Contractor name: the one most of its contracts list.
columns.license_id: License number as DPWH lists it (OECO_… for a foreign contractor); empty when none is given.
columns.marked_revoked_in_dpwh_list: "yes" when DPWH’s list tags the license "[REVOKED]".
columns.contract_amount_php: Their contract amount. A joint-venture contract counts in full for each partner.
columns.joint_venture_contracts: Of those, contracts naming another contractor too.
columns.first_year: First year with a contract (DPWH’s year).
columns.dpwh_offices: DPWH offices that awarded its contracts.
columns.main_office: The office with the largest amount.
columns.contracts_linked_to_gaa_lines: Contracts matched to a GAA line, FY2020–FY2026.
columns.other_names: Other names its contracts list, up to five.

files.title: GAA lines and the contracts matched to them, FY2020–FY2026
files.about: One row per GAA line and matched contract, with how it was matched. Our match, not DPWH’s record.

columns.line_id: "gaa:<year>:<UACS code>" (":<office>" added for the 2 codes split over two offices); the same IDs as the multi-purpose buildings map.
columns.gaa_title: The line’s title in the GAA.
columns.gaa_office: The office the GAA lists for the line.
columns.contract_id: The DPWH contract matched to the line.
columns.dpwh_url: DPWH’s own page for that contract.
columns.contract_php: Contract amount; for a cluster, the whole contract, shared with its other lines.
columns.source_of_funds: Fund source; its GAA year is the line’s year.
columns.method: one_to_one (one contract for the line) or bundle (one contract for several lines, a DPWH "cluster").
columns.searched: Where the contract was found: same office, same region, or all offices (Central Office lines).
columns.title_score: Title agreement, rapidfuzz token-set ratio (90 or more; 95 within the region).
columns.amount_ratio: Contract amount over the line’s (over the lines’ together for a cluster), 0.5 to 1.02.
columns.candidates: Contracts that qualified for the line; 1 means it was the only one.

files.title: Every DPWH GAA line, FY2020–FY2026, matched or not
files.about: One row per DPWH capital-outlay line of the GAA, with its match status, contract and contractor.

columns.line_id: Line ID, as in the line-contracts table.
columns.pap: UACS program, activity or project code.
columns.region: Region of the GAA operating unit.
columns.match: one_to_one, bundle or none: whether a contract was matched, and how.
columns.contract_php: The contract amount; for a cluster, the whole contract.
